To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the neutrino decay to unparticle is a possible mechanism for the ultra high energy neutrino production.
the unparticle decay of neutrino has significant effects on the ultra high energy neutrino flux and the unparticle decay can also be detected by a kilometer scale detector.
the unparticle effects are significant for neutrino energies of order 10 20 eV and above.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following topics: 1. The neutrino decay in the unparticle scenario.
the unparticle scenario and its effect on the ultra high energy neutrino flux.
the following topics: neutrino physics, ultra high energy neutrino astronomy and unparticle physics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of unparticle decay is negligible for the ultra high energy neutrino from GRB.
the effect of neutrino decay in the unparticle scenario would not affect the detection of the ultra high energy neutrino from the GRB.
the unparticle scenario would have a significant effect in the detection of ultra high energy (E > 1019 eV) neutrinos.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the unparticle decay of neutrino would not be significant for ultra high energy neutrino from GRB.
the neutrino decay into unparticle would not affect the detection yield of ultra high energy GRB neutrinos in a kilometer size ice-Cerenkov detectors.
the unparticle scenario can not be ruled out for the case of UHE neutrinos from GRBs.
The main takeaway from our work is that

for a given unparticle scale, the decay rate of the neutrino in unparticle model is higher than that in the standard model, which leads to an increase in the detection rate of the kilometer scale detector.
for unparticle scale $Λ_U \gtrsim 10^{11} \mathrm{GeV}$, the unparticle effect can be neglected in the context of ultra high energy cosmic neutrinos.
the unparticle decay of neutrino is not a dominant channel of neutrino decay for the case under consideration.
